column2: It can't be helped... I'll use $$召喚魔法$$, too!
I knew it!!
You are $$ルピルピ$$ after all!!
Is it really... you, $$お師匠様$$?!
So it was you, $$ルピルピ$$... Forgive me.
Though I have no face to show you ever again...
B-but... What are you doing here!?
Lord $$ユダ$$ ordered me to defeat the wanted fugitives...
I see...
So we must fight after all...
H-hey, $$お師匠さま$$!!
Honestly, how rude!
You've never understood how I feel, not even once!!
Needless to say!
My knowledge has always stood alongside yours, $$お師匠様$$!!
But $$お師匠さま$$...
If I don't return, $$ユダ$$ will surely dispatch pursuers here at once!
No need to hesitate! I'll send them packing!
Are you truly sure, $$ルピルピ$$?
Oh my, what a foolish question, $$お師匠さま$$!!
$$お師匠さま$$ has returned. Of course I, his disciple, will go with him!
I never considered myself one of $$ユダ$$'s companions.
